correctness.rationale: The positive mixed two-pole response H=(1+i m a w)/[(1+i a w)(1+i r a w)] yields phi=arctan(a w)+arctan(r a w)-arctan(m a w), 1<m<r. Differentiation gives numerator C+Bx+Ax² for x=(a w)², A=rm((r+1)m-r)>0 and C=1+r-m>0. Independently checked symbolic discriminant factor B²-4AC=(r-m)(m-1)(r+1)Q_r(m) and B+Q_r(m)=-6rm, with Q quadratic in m and discriminant (r-1)²(r²-14r+1). A negative derivative interval occurs iff Q>0; its roots are in (1,r) exactly r>7+4sqrt3, with two stationary frequencies and monotone double-root equality cases. Algebraic sign arguments cover all positive parameters; finite rational examples alone do not.
